title: CycleDossier
description: The aggregated, committed record of one evolve-loop cycle (ADR-0055). Written to knowledge-base/cycles/cycle-N.json by dossier.Write at closeout; validated by evolve dossier verify.

run_id.description: CA.2 run ULID — unique per run, threads every ledger entry.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA shipped this cycle (empty when cycle did not ship).

tree_sha.description: Git tree SHA of the shipped commit.

started_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the cycle started.

ended_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the cycle ended.

phases.description: Ordered phase records (one per executed phase).

decisions.description: Key decisions made during this cycle.

carryover.description: Work items for the next cycle (required when final_verdict=FAIL).

skipped_phases.description: Phases that genuinely did NOT run, with the cause (closeout after an abnormal mid-cycle exit). A phase that RAN and returned non-PASS belongs in phases_run_verdict_not_adopted, never here.

phases_run_verdict_not_adopted.description: Non-floor phases that RAN and returned non-PASS after the floor verdict was set, so their verdict was declined rather than allowed to overwrite the floor-derived final_verdict (cycle-802).

spine_fail_opens.description: Every spine-gate fail-open the cycle took: the phase entered anyway, the first unsatisfied predecessor anchor, and the reason (cycle-1166).

model_source.description: Model provenance: profile | pin | advisor. Absent on a legacy timing log.

resolved_model.description: The concrete model or tier the phase actually ran on.

VerdictNotAdopted.description: One phase that ran to completion whose non-PASS verdict was not adopted as the cycle verdict. verdict is what the phase actually returned (FAIL|WARN|SKIPPED).

missing_artifact.description: The FIRST unsatisfied predecessor anchor — the real cause. Phase alone cannot group fail-opens by cause.

reason.description: The fail-open reason verbatim: "would-block at enforce" vs "digest degraded: …".

TimingSummary.description: Cycle-level latency and token roll-up, ingested from phase-timing.json (phasetiming.Summary). Absent when the cycle wrote no timing log. All token fields are zero on a legacy log written before they existed — never fabricated.

retried_count.description: Dispatches that took more than one attempt.

wasted_tokens.description: Usage spent by FAIL-verdict entries — work that did not ship.

cache_hit_ratio.description: cache_read/(input+cache_read) over the whole cycle; 0 when there was no input.

hot_phase_count.description: Phases whose context_fill_ratio reached contextfill.HotThreshold (0.85, inclusive). Entries with no resolvable tier (ratio absent) are never counted.

hot_phases.description: Names of the phases counted by hot_phase_count. Omitted when none ran hot.

FailureRecord.description: The FAIL cycle's failure identity, ingested from the workspace artifacts failure-digest.json (fingerprint + pre_class) and audit-fail-reason.json (reasons, <=5 entries of <=200 chars each). Absent on non-FAIL cycles and when the artifacts yielded no content — best-effort, never fabricated.

CIWatchRecord.description: Remote GitHub CI verdict for the cycle's pushed commit, ingested from ci-watch-verdict.json (cycle-748 push-ci-watch-remote-parity). Absent when no watch verdict was recorded — never fabricated.
